name: Run payroll
description: Pays every person on the staff list once, after approval, through the connected payments account.

steps.name: Work out the month and use your business name

output.period: =has(trigger.body) && has(trigger.body.period) ? string(trigger.body.period) : string(timestamp(has(trigger.scheduled_time) ? trigger.scheduled_time : run.started_at).getFullYear('Africa/Lagos')) + '-' + (timestamp(has(trigger.scheduled_time) ? trigger.scheduled_time : run.started_at).getMonth('Africa/Lagos') < 9 ? '0' : '') + string(timestamp(has(trigger.scheduled_time) ? trigger.scheduled_time : run.started_at).getMonth('Africa/Lagos') + 1)

steps.name: Read the staff list
Check each person has an amount and bank details

output.people: =(has(steps.read_staff.output.rows) ? steps.read_staff.output.rows : []).filter(r, has(r.net_pay) && r.net_pay != null && double(r.net_pay) >= 1.0 && has(r.bank_code) && r.bank_code != null && string(r.bank_code) != '' && has(r.account_number) && r.account_number != null && string(r.account_number) != '' && string(r.account_number).size() == 10 && has(r.account_name) && r.account_name != null && string(r.account_name) != '').map(r, {'id': has(r.id) ? string(r.id) : '', 'name': (has(r.name) && r.name != null && string(r.name) != '' ? string(r.name) : (has(r.account_name) && r.account_name != null ? string(r.account_name) : 'Row ' + (has(r.id) ? string(r.id) : ''))), 'kobo': int(math.round(double(r.net_pay) * 100.0)), 'bank_code': string(r.bank_code), 'account_number': string(r.account_number), 'account_name': string(r.account_name), 'phone': (has(r.phone) && r.phone != null ? string(r.phone) : '')})
output.refused: =(has(steps.read_staff.output.rows) ? steps.read_staff.output.rows : []).filter(r, !(has(r.net_pay) && r.net_pay != null && double(r.net_pay) >= 1.0 && has(r.bank_code) && r.bank_code != null && string(r.bank_code) != '' && has(r.account_number) && r.account_number != null && string(r.account_number) != '' && string(r.account_number).size() == 10 && has(r.account_name) && r.account_name != null && string(r.account_name) != '')).map(r, {'name': (has(r.name) && r.name != null && string(r.name) != '' ? string(r.name) : (has(r.account_name) && r.account_name != null ? string(r.account_name) : 'Row ' + (has(r.id) ? string(r.id) : ''))), 'reason': (!(has(r.net_pay) && r.net_pay != null && double(r.net_pay) >= 1.0) ? 'no amount to pay' : !(has(r.account_number) && r.account_number != null && string(r.account_number).size() == 10) ? 'the account number is not 10 digits' : 'the bank details are incomplete')})

steps.name: Check each account's name with the bank
Find the name on the account

output.name: =item.name
output.reason: the bank did not find this account

steps.name: Compare it with the staff list
List who will be paid

output.pay: =steps.check.output.people.filter(p, p.id in steps.names.output.filter(o, has(o.match) && o.match.ok).map(o, o.match.id))
output.total_kobo: =sum(steps.check.output.people.filter(p, p.id in steps.names.output.filter(o, has(o.match) && o.match.ok).map(o, o.match.id)).map(p, p.kobo))
output.flagged: =steps.names.output.filter(o, !(has(o.match) && o.match.ok)).map(o, has(o.match) ? {'name': o.match.name, 'reason': 'the bank has this account as ' + o.match.found} : {'name': o.lookup_failed.name, 'reason': o.lookup_failed.reason})

steps.name: Check the balance
Get the payroll approved

subject.warning: =steps.balance.output.available_kobo >= steps.ready.output.total_kobo ? '' : 'The balance is less than the total to pay'

steps.name: Pay each person
The person
Pay the salary
Wait for the bank to confirm
Tell the person they were paid

input.message: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ': your salary for ' + steps.settings.output.period + ', NGN ' + string(item.kobo / 100) + ', has been paid. Thank you for your work.'

steps.name: Tell the person they were paid

input.message: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ': your salary for ' + steps.settings.output.period + ', NGN ' + string(item.kobo / 100) + ', has been paid. Thank you for your work.'

steps.name: Work out each person's outcome

output.rows: =steps.pay_all.output.map(o, {'period': steps.settings.output.period, 'staff_name': o.person.name, 'amount_naira': double(o.person.kobo) / 100.0, 'rail': 'main' != '' ? 'main' : 'payments', 'status': (has(o.pay_failed) ? 'failed' : o.pay.status == 'settled' ? 'paid' : o.pay.status == 'failed' ? 'failed' : has(o.settle) ? (o.settle.status == 'settled' ? 'paid' : o.settle.status) : 'unconfirmed'), 'payout_id': has(o.pay) && has(o.pay.payout_id) ? o.pay.payout_id : '', 'reason': (has(o.pay_failed) ? o.pay_failed.reason : has(o.pay.reason) ? o.pay.reason : has(o.settle) && has(o.settle.reason) ? o.settle.reason : has(o.settle_failed) ? 'the payment was not confirmed' : ''), 'settled_at': has(o.settle) && has(o.settle.settled_at) ? o.settle.settled_at : ''})

steps.name: Add up the payroll
Record each payment
Record the payroll
Tell the owner how the payroll went

input.title: ='Payroll ' + steps.settings.output.period
input.message: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ' payroll for ' + steps.settings.output.period + ': ' + string(steps.summary.output.paid) + ' paid (NGN ' + string(steps.summary.output.paid_naira) + '), ' + string(steps.summary.output.failed) + ' failed, ' + string(steps.summary.output.unconfirmed) + ' not confirmed yet. Fees: NGN ' + string(steps.summary.output.fees_naira) + '.' + (size(steps.summary.output.not_paid) > 0 ? ' Not paid: ' + steps.summary.output.not_paid.join(', ') + '.' : '')

steps.name: Watch each bank payment for a reversal
Watch for the payment coming back
Record the reversal
Tell the owner a salary came back

input.title: A salary came back
input.message: =item.staff_name + '\'s salary for ' + item.period + ' (NGN ' + string(item.amount_naira) + ') came back from the bank. Nobody was paid again: check their account details, then pay them yourself.'

steps.name: Record that the payroll was not approved
Tell the owner nothing was paid

input.title: ='Payroll ' + steps.settings.output.period + ' not paid'
input.message: =steps.settings.output.business_name + ' payroll for ' + steps.settings.output.period + ' was ' + (has(steps.approve.output.reason) && steps.approve.output.reason == 'timeout' ? 'not approved in time' : 'rejected') + ', so nobody was paid.'
